system.name: UNIP (UNified Infrared Pre-training)
system.one_liner: Benchmark RGB pre-trained models on infrared segmentation, explain the gaps through attention patterns, then distil hybrid attention into small models with InfMix, NMI-HAD and LL-FPN.

content.variant_note: three tinted bands titled by research questions (Step1 benchmark, Step2 attention analysis, Step3 method), each summarising one part of the paper and joined by labelled coloured arrows
content.argues: Benchmark findings and attention analysis motivate each design choice of UNIP: the hybrid attention pattern, NMI, the distribution shift and the performance/cost ratio each inspire a component.
content.subject: The paper's chain of thought: benchmark charts, a chain of claims with attention maps, and the UNIP method with dataset, teacher-student distillation and feature pyramid.

lessons.what_to_learn: Turn the paper's structure into a chain of thought: tinted bands titled by research questions, with each insight given one colour that follows its text, its labelled arrow and the method component it inspires, so the reader sees which finding motivates which design choice.
lessons.suits: Analysis-driven papers (benchmark, then diagnosis, then method) whose method choices follow from measured findings.

summary: UNIP studies how RGB pre-trained models transfer to infrared semantic segmentation and builds a better recipe for small models. Figure 1 lays out the paper's chain of thought as three tinted bands titled by questions. Step 1 benchmarks pre-trained models: supervised and contrastive pre-training beat masked image modelling, and large models give a poor performance/cost ratio, shown by two small bar charts. Step 2 explains why through a chain of claims from pre-training task to attention pattern, measured by NMI, with DINO-S and MAE-S attention maps and a distribution-shift claim. Step 3 presents UNIP: the InfMix dataset, NMI-guided hybrid attention distillation from a teacher to a student, and a last-layer feature pyramid. Coloured arrows labelled 'inspire' tie each insight to the component it motivates.
summary_zh: UNIP 研究 RGB 预训练迁移到红外分割。图 1 用三条问句色带讲思路：Step1 基准测试，Step2 以注意力模式和 NMI 解释差异，Step3 提出 InfMix、NMI-HAD 蒸馏与末层特征金字塔，彩色箭头连接发现与设计。
